يتعاكس (form VI)
# يَتَعَاكَسُ (yataʕākasu) /ja.ta.ʕaː.ka.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَعَاكَسَ (taʕākasa)
# يَتَعَاكَسَ (yataʕākasa) /ja.ta.ʕaː.ka.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاكَسَ (taʕākasa)
# يَتَعَاكَسْ (yataʕākas) /ja.ta.ʕaː.kas/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَعَاكَسَ (taʕākasa)
